subject: general
question: Where is the Kala Ghoda Arts Festival organised every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Kala Ghoda Arts Festival** is an annual cultural festival held in the Kala Ghoda area of South Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• The festival was first started in **1999** and has since grown to become one of the most iconic art and cultural events in India.
 
• Organized by the **Kala Ghoda Association**, the event aims to preserve and promote art and heritage in the region.
 
• The festival spans nine days in early February each year, showcasing art, music, dance, theatre, literature, workshops, and culinary delights.
 
• It is a free-to-attend event, attracting thousands of visitors from across India and the world, making it a hub for cultural exchange and creativity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kala Ghoda:**

 
 
• Named after the iconic black horse (Kala Ghoda in Hindi) statue that once stood in the area.
 
• The Kala Ghoda precinct is known for its heritage buildings and vibrant cultural atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **The Festival's Offerings:**
 
 
• Covers diverse categories such as visual arts, cinema, theatre, literature, and architecture.
 
• Includes activities for children, heritage walks, and eco-friendly initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Impact on the Community:**
 
 
• Proceeds from the festival are used by the Kala Ghoda Association for the restoration of heritage buildings and public spaces.
 
• It serves as a platform for budding artists and performers to showcase their talent on an international stage.
 
 
 
• **Tourism and Economy:**
 
 
• The festival boosts tourism in Mumbai, drawing art enthusiasts, tourists, and locals alike.
 
• Contributes to the local economy through increased footfall in nearby businesses and markets.
